blocks.x: Every component in Cloud-Native & Legacy Modernization has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Cloud-Native & Legacy Modernization capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
